tests.name: R1 (T53) two calls, one stating a cost and one stating none but priced, sum into cost_reported_sum and cost_estimated_sum apart; a call with neither adds to unpriced_calls and no sum; an unstated cache_read stays unstated (control: a negative token count is refused, counting nothing)

R2 (T53; B1) usd is allowed only on an account whose plan's money is reported or priced: on none and on OPEN it is refused LIMIT_UNIT_UNAVAILABLE, writing nothing; tokens and calls are set on all (control: the same owner's plan changed to reported accepts usd)

R3 R6 R9 (T53) a member's explore use is read by account_id: her account's explore yes passes useCheck for explore and ask lets her ask; with no account named, another member's account named, or her account at no, it is EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED (control)

R4 R21 (T53) a none plan's month answers tokens and calls and not_measurable, no cost field equal to 0; a priced plan answers both cost sums apart; a non-owner is refused as R2 refuses (control: an owner of a reported plan sees cost_reported_sum)

R5 (T53) a recorded provider limit appears once with its key per owner, kind and resets_at; a second read mints no new key; to the account's owners alone (control: past resets_at it no longer appears)

R11 (T53) actualOf answers a run's actual cost after, cost_reported and cost_estimated apart, only to the paying account's owners; an unpriced act answers not_measurable, never 0; to anyone else, and for an act not measured, found false
R14 (T53) a none plan's days answer cost: null with not_measurable, never zero, its tokens and calls shown; with no limit set its one period is in tokens (control: a priced plan's is in usd)

R15 (T53) countUsage and countAskUsage take the conversation's label, whose effort is a lowercase word of at most EFFORT_WORD_MAX letters or null; any other value is AI_RUN_CONSUME_INVALID, counting nothing (control: the longest word and null are kept)

R18 a spent-cap limit recorded with a reset time makes useCheck refuse (source provider) until that time and not after; recorded twice it stores one row; a null reset time allows a probe after PROVIDER_REPROBE_MS (control: a plain rate-limit error is not a limit and is refused, recording nothing)

R19 aiProviderLimits answers an owner the standing limit and its reset time, a past one in the history only, naming no member; a non-owner is refused as R12 refuses (control: an account with none answers empty lists)

R20 a walk moves from an account at its own limit to the next account, judged on that account's own limits, never the first's; it does not move from a switched-off use (control: with no list, the act is refused as before)
R21 (T53) a unit other than usd is summed only with its own unit: a euro cost is kept apart and not added into the usd sum (control: two usd costs add)

R22 estimateSwitch: a run with stated input tokens on a priced target answers the cold-cache range (input price low, cache-write price high, per million); an unpriced target answers not_known, never zero; a same-owner hop says payer_change null (control: a non-owner, non-member is refused as R12 refuses)

R23 a percent threshold on a set day limit is stored, several per scope; with no limit it is AI_THRESHOLD_INVALID naming the field; a member who is not the owner is refused as R2 refuses; usd only where the plan's money allows (control: an amount threshold needs no limit)
R24 crossing a percent threshold produces one entry whose key is the same on every read that period; a new period produces a new key; a usd threshold says its basis (control: under the level, none)

R25 reconcile: matching figures answer within_tolerance true; a gap above RECONCILE_TOLERANCE is flagged and recorded with who and when; a null theirs is not compared (control: a non-owner is refused as R12 refuses, recording nothing)
R26 a scan of the module's source and test files finds none of the four model-id prefixes R26 names, and its requirement text no model id (control: the scan catches a planted file containing one)

R27 two members' uses on a team account are answered by name to an administrator, a project account's to its owner, sorted by cost then tokens (control: a non-owner is refused as R12 refuses; asked for member:<id> it is NOT_A_PAYING_ACCOUNT even for an administrator)

R28 with re-testing on and under the cap a re-test is allowed; at the cap it answers cap_reached; each cap is an R2 limit (retest:<entry>, usd, month) recorded who and when (control: on false answers off for every entry; a non-owner of the paying account is refused as R12 refuses)

R29 switching re-testing off makes retestingOff answer one entry for the account's administrators with who and when; off again adds none and keeps the key; on ends it (control: a non-administrator is answered none)
R30 no function here writes a lifecycle state: a scan of the module's source finds no write to the catalogue and no lifecycle op (control: the scan catches a planted write)

R31 three turns on one fake entry, one refused and one timeout, give that day calls 3, refused 1, errors.timeout 1; it keeps no owner, account, member or content (control: a limit outcome adds to calls only; an outcome or class outside agent-model's lists is refused, counting nothing)
R32 a new team's switch is off; an administrator turns it on, appended with who and when (control: a member who is not an administrator is refused and the switch is unchanged)

R33 with the switch on, two counted days yield two reports with exactly those keys, entries under HEALTH_MIN_CALLS left out; after healthSent a day is not answered again; personal calls appear in no report or preview (control: off it answers null, and the preview still answers the report it would send)
R7 (T53) the tables hold no content, secret or provider message: no column names one, and a row with a provider message is refused by the schema (control: the same row without it is kept)

R8 (T53) each code this module mints has its row in its own checks.mjs, family C-143 (K2480), numbered once, never a retired run-rules number; AI_THRESHOLD_INVALID the next free number (control: the retired codes are not this module's)

notice membership:77 (membership R154: the moved names are delegates of member-roster's) ai-use's owner checks read membership's isAdministrator, isProjectOwner and notAnAdmin as member-roster answers them: a group refusal is byte for byte notAnAdmin's (control: an administrator and a project owner act)

not_verified: R10's entry fallback (agent-model.estimate, its R34, not yet built) and R13's new keys in the design stream's words.json: both marks left, the reasons in the file's Suggestions. Not run: the users' suites against the new signatures (question-explorer, ai-runs, notice-producers, answers pass account_id, entry_id and label in their own jobs); the plane through its door for the new ops aiusebymember, airetestset, aihealthset and aihealthpreview, which op-declarations does not yet declare. R28's 'entries teams use' is left to ai-gate's canary schedule.
